image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a pile of cooked Dungeness crabs. The crabs exhibit the characteristic bright orange-red coloration of cooked crustaceans. The image focuses on the carapaces and chelipeds (claws) of multiple overlapping crabs. The texture appears glossy and wet, consistent with cooked seafood. Several claws are prominent in the foreground, showing the jointed structure and dark tips.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The outer surfaces of the claws appear smooth. While the serrations on the inner edge are difficult to resolve at this resolution, the general morphology matches, and no contradictory artifacts (like melting) are seen.
